title: A failed QuickBooks check shows one message and Name still sorts
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • {Location-A} is connected to QuickBooks, so the QuickBooks column normally shows.
  • Category {Category-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PCA03 alpha) exists.
  • Category {Category-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PCA03 Beta) exists.
  • The QuickBooks connection check fails when the Categories page opens. A manual tester cannot cause this by hand. The setup doc, Part 2, explains how a Claude session makes the check fail.
  • You are on a page other than Categories.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Categories in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Read every message that appears on screen.
  3. Look at the column headers of the list.
  4. Click the Name column header.
  5. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  6. Read the Name header arrow and the order of {Category-A} and {Category-B}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: exactly one message appears, reading "Unable to check QuickBooks connection. Please try again." No second, general error message appears.
  • Step 3: the QuickBooks Products And Services column is not shown. The list itself has loaded.
  • Step 6: the Name header arrow points down and {Category-B} is above {Category-A}. The Name column still sorts.
  • Steps 1 to 6: if the QuickBooks check could not be made to fail, this case cannot be checked by hand. Write 'not checked by hand' in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10134 (Story 1, Categories, sort by name; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S1-N5, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.2 (Categories - after), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Product comment: Chris Ward, 23 Sep 2026 (Confluence comment 882311473), third comment item 3: 'Only our message. Suppress the generic handler for this failure'. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Price/Category QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-N5: “If the connection cannot be checked, the column is not shown and the user is told once: "Unable to check QuickBooks connection. Please try again." That is the only message shown for the failure: the app's generic error message for the same failed request is suppressed, so the user never sees two. The list itself still loads and the Name column still sorts.”
